findings.issue: Version 5.0.0 is not in the item or visible story text. The note that the yaml holds both admin paths contradicts CG-ALL-2894 and 2895.
AC12 and its BR4, BR5 and BR10 Thens assert cases (empty sent_at, failed or stale score answer, out-of-list values) that no Given sets up.
The item asks for 404 answers of the provided operations. AC13 and TC-16 instead test a path the contract does not provide.
AC14 says the timed-out activity is 'shown with its timeout', a display behaviour that neither the item nor the visible story supports.
